profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary: Broadly experienced engineer with an M.S. in Electrical Engineering and a focus on hardware/software systems and computer architecture.  Previously an experienced IT professional and web developer working with custom integrations and advanced network architecture.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Currently learning new technologies and helping small businesses get started.  Latest interests include neuromorphic computing, SSR Vue/React apps, containerizing everything, and WebAssembly.

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
Solely responsible for webapp front end, static landing page, and 3rd party web
plugins/tools. Stack included a backend in Go, frontend with RiotJS, landing page on
Wordpress, and infrastructure hosted on both AWS and Google Cloud.

• Raised our Google search ranking from 30+ to consistently in the top 3 for our
5 top keywords with an SEO focused approach to landing page redesign.

• Decreased downtime and eased debugging by implementing tracing and
monitoring for all infrastructure through Datadog, Rollbar, PagerDuty, and
custom services.

• Provided company insight into product use and enabled future interactive
features by designing and developing an internal analytics engine utilizing
Google Big Query and Pub/Sub messaging. Designed to be easily integrated
with DataFlow for machine learning and automated actions.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Led mobile development through two public release cycles on both iOS and Android.
Hybrid app development using Ionic 1 with Angular 1 and utilizing both JavaScript
and TypeScript.

• Drove the first sale of the company product by releasing MVP features such as
device firmware updates and live device monitoring.

• Enabled customers to manage devices in offline conditions by assisting in data
architecture forIoT device network and implementing mobile app solution.

• Increased small team productivity by assisting with embedded development in
C, tools in Python, and cloud services in Python on a Django platform deployed
to AWS.

positions.title: IT Consultant and Web Developer
positions.description:
Support small businesses with IT administration, software development, and system
architecture. Personal research in new technologies.

• Exceeded performance metrics required for 3 engines on a single board when
developing a custom quadrangle graphics rasterization engine on FPGA for
Misapplied Sciences’ Parallel Reality.

• Drastically increased inbound traffic from search and enabled long term ease of
use by implementing multiple small business landing pages using primarily
Wordpress and Drupal with an SEO focus.

• Improved network stability when managing Windows and Linux networks, most
between 10-100 machines, including SIP phone systems, virtualization, P2P
wireless links, PCI compliance, and cloud migrations.

• Increased business productivity by utilizing PHP, Javascript, and Python to
develop internal applications to automate or assist employee tasks.

positions.title: Wireless Engineer
positions.description: Manage team of installers providing field installation and support over a 3 state area.  Provide testing and backend management of customer premise equipment as well as tower equipment.  Provide escalation support to phone technical support team.
